capture_metadata.schedule: case,graph seed,sampling seed; warmup then timed; repetition then order0..4; algorithm=(order+repetition)%5
capture_metadata.timing_boundary: Common native tuple input; public native result types. KKT/compactor conversion and temporary input destruction timed; returned result destruction and exact validation excluded. UTC/CPU clocks enclose steady interval.
capture_metadata.certificate_scope: Exactly one independent native reference certificate per child, followed by exact unique-MST ID/tuple validation for every row.

resource_rule.measure: Sum of ps RSS KiB over child process group; sampled, not a continuous peak; shared pages may be counted more than once.
resource_rule.failure: Terminate above ceiling or after three consecutive ps failures; retain every partial artifact.

aggregation: median repetitions, then sampling seeds, then graph seeds; paired ratios aggregated independently
